name: Merchant Cash Advance Agreement
description: A purchase of a business's future receivables for a lump sum, repaid as a share of daily sales — also called revenue-based or sales-based financing. The checks read for a confession of judgment, a right to reconcile payments to actual receipts, the percentage of receipts purchased, what any personal guaranty covers, and the authorization to debit the merchant's account. Distinct from `loan-agreement`, which reads a loan with interest, and from `factoring-agreement`, which reads a sale of existing invoices.

title_keywords: purchase and sale of future receivables
